resolvedFindings.title: Specify the shared preview scope and its visible outcome
resolvedFindings.evidence: ED-PLAYER now names active-video/no-selection, inclusive complete-composition range and earliest-to-latest selected-object composed-span playback including gaps and other-track contributions. TL-RANGE places the scope summary beside transport and specifies Stop at the resolved frame plus follow/pan recovery. Connected s01/s02/s03/s06 text preserves numeric selection and distinguishes staged trim from committed extent.
resolvedFindings.impact: The UI handoff can portray object selection as isolated-clip playback or omit the inclusive preview extent even though the frozen source requires composition playback across that span. It also leaves the visible stopped position/follow state unspecified for the shared transport.
resolvedFindings.specificCorrection: Extend ED-PLAYER/TL-RANGE and the shared transport description with the three source-defined preview scopes, inclusive End, and a visible association between current selection extent and playback scope. State that Stop retains the resolved player/playhead frame and that playback follows until intentional timeline pan. Preserve current geometry freedom and the existing 14-state set; no extra state or new policy is required.

resolvedFindings.title: Make the accepted commit-freeze control availability explicit
resolvedFindings.evidence: Shared commit text and s11 busy explicitly disable Play/Stop, scrubbing and frame stepping; keep player Zoom In/Out/Fit/magnified pan and timeline zoom/pan available within ordinary limits; preserve frame/draft/selection/insertion and restore eligible controls only after an actual result.
resolvedFindings.impact: UI can follow this description yet disable accepted inspection controls or leave controls active that change the captured stopped frame during the save. This is an interaction-state distinction rather than a cosmetic styling choice.
resolvedFindings.specificCorrection: In the shared commit-freeze description and s11-video-saving-busy, explicitly keep player Zoom In/Zoom Out/Fit/pan and timeline zoom/pan available subject to their ordinary limits, and explicitly disable Play/Stop, scrubbing and frame stepping during the actual commit. Keep the captured preview/frame and selection/insertion intact; restore eligible controls only after the actual result. Do not add percentage progress, cancellation or queued commands.
